beforeDevCommand.script: cargo build -p aion2-relay -p aion2-proxy && mkdir crates\aion2-app\binaries 2>nul & copy /Y target\debug\aion2-relay.exe crates\aion2-app\binaries\aion2-relay >nul && cd ui && npm run dev

beforeBuildCommand.script: cargo build -p aion2-relay -p aion2-proxy --release && mkdir crates\aion2-app\binaries 2>nul & copy /Y target\release\aion2-relay.exe crates\aion2-app\binaries\aion2-relay >nul & copy /Y target\release\aion2-proxy.exe crates\aion2-app\binaries\aion2-proxy.exe >nul && cd ui && npm run build

bundle.shortDescription: Game traffic proxy for Aion2 Taiwan
bundle.longDescription: Routes Aion2 Taiwan game traffic through a Taiwan relay VPS to bypass geo-blocking with minimal latency.
